'''DecipherCon 1999 Gauntlet''' was a Star Wars CCG side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (11–14 November 1999, Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia). [[Matt Lush]] won the Thursday heat, out of 9 players over 4 games.<ref name="dc99sw30_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW30_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: The Gauntlet Dual Format], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000602202806/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW30_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Side event (The Gauntlet: Dual Formats)
* '''Format:''' [[The Gauntlet: Dual Formats]]<ref name="dc99-thu">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Thursday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021005063305/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Saturday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026023004/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Date:''' Thursday 11 November 1999, 2 p.m.–10 p.m.; Saturday 13 November 1999, 9 p.m.–5 a.m.
* '''Site:''' Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia
